verdicts.quote: Join, wait, receive an offer, leave, decline, or let an offer expire. None of those actions adds a charge, fee, or payment hold.

verdicts.quote: find the occurrence's offer, its deadline, and the available actions to claim or decline. External delivery through email, SMS, or push is outside the required notification surface
Race multiple confirmations for the last seat, whether through simultaneous direct bookings, simultaneous claims, or one of each. At most one additional booking confirms.
As the offer owner, start booking from the occurrence's ordinary class details. The app recognizes the current offer and gives the member a route to claim it before its deadline.
force a claim to fail after a provisional payment step. Once the app reports the outcome as settled, any provisional charge or hold has been cleared under the ordinary failed-booking terms.
An otherwise valid join has no additional product-imposed queue-size cap ... the number of existing waiting members alone never causes refusal.
Waitlist activity closes when the occurrence stops accepting bookings or reaches its scheduled start, whichever comes first
lower effective capacity to 2 ... The higher-priority offer remains active for its original deadline, and the other ceases to hold a seat.
Cancel a full class with a waiting member. The member can see that the class was cancelled and that their request will no longer be considered.
distinguish these outcomes: confirmed booking, active offer with a seat held, waiting without an offer, or none of those three.
